The sharp foreground portrait shows the same woman, curly hair and sweater as the attachment.
No hair or shoulder area visible in the source is lost.
The portrait is not stretched or squeezed.
Any added background space uses a blurred version of the source photo, with no text.

answer_sheet.Text and retouching: No text or retouching; preserve my appearance.

events.text: Credits have run out, so I can't run the edit. Even the cheapest model costs 5 credits, and retrying with another model won't help. I'll explain that and offer a free manual way to do the edit instead.

I couldn't make the story image. Magic Hour refused the request because your account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was created and I have no download link for you.

I used the cheapest edit option on the Free plan (5 credits for one image), so trying a different model won't help. Once you add credits or your free credits refresh, I can run it again. The request will be:
- **Size:** 9:16 vertical, 640px on the long edge (the Free plan's limit)
- **Layout:** your original photo in the middle at full width, uncropped, so all your hair and both shoulders show
- **Background:** a blurred, slightly enlarged copy of the same park photo fills the space above and below
- **No text**, logos or borders

**You can also do this now for free:** Instagram's story editor does nearly the same thing. Add the photo to a story and pinch it so the whole square fits. Instagram fills the top and bottom with a blurred version or colours taken from the photo. Apps like Canva or CapCut have a "blur background" fill for 9:16 that gives the same look at full resolution.
